note: Grouped only where two ids name the same artefact: CRediT, AIAS, the ICMJE four criteria, C2PA, CHART, GAIDeT and the two-lane approach account for every merge, and inside each group every id comes from a different paper. I refused to merge schemes that merely resemble each other - the dozen independently invented tiered or four-level AI-disclosure scales, the two traffic-light schemes, the journal-specific tiered frameworks - and I refused the script's dimension-overlap cluster, which only chained six unrelated one-dimension schemes together; two ids from the same paper were never merged, since one extraction pass gave them distinct ids on purpose. Out of scope is kept narrow: system-autonomy taxonomies, harm and incident taxonomies, tool inventories, literacy scales and a curriculum structure, with every close call kept in scope and flagged in its note.
